# `kernel/schema/OsSchemas.js`

> **Source:** `webgpu-os/kernel/schema/OsSchemas.js`

OsSchemas.js — all OS-level schema definitions. Registers schemas into the shared SchemaRegistry singleton. Call initOsSchemas() once during KernelBootstrap. Registered names: os.AppManifest      — app discovery manifest (manifest.json) os.AppSetting       — one settings descriptor inside a manifest os.ModManifest      — mod discovery manifest os.ModHook          — one hook entry in a mod manifest os.IPCMessage       — IPC channel message envelope os.VFSNode          — virtual filesystem node metadata os.GPUSurface       — GPU surface descriptor os.VRAMEntry        — per-app VRAM usage report os.ProcessEntry     — process table entry os.PermissionCheck  — permission check result os.Particle         — particle struct for binary packing (6 × f32) os.ParticleBatch    — array of particles os.NetPeerMessage   — envelope sent between OS peers via NetDriver os.AppAICapabilityManifest — Particle Realms Protocol tool/resource/prompt/root declaration

## Notes & Examples

### Command Bus Pattern

The OS uses a capability-gated command bus for inter-app and system communication. Apps register command handlers; the kernel routes commands based on capabilities. Commands can be local (same app), cross-app (with permission), or system-level (elevated).

**Example: Command registration and invocation**
```js
import { CommandBus } from 'webgpu-os/kernel/CommandBus.js';
import { Capability } from 'webgpu-os/kernel/Capability.js';

const bus = new CommandBus();

// Register a handler (requires 'ui' capability)
bus.register('myapp:openFile', async (path) => {
  const content = await storage.read(path);
  return { content, size: content.length };
}, { capability: 'storage' });

// Invoke locally
const result = await bus.invoke('myapp:openFile', '/docs/readme.md');

// Cross-app invocation (requires 'interop' capability)
const otherApp = bus.proxy('otherapp');
const data = await otherApp.invoke('otherapp:compute', input);

// Broadcast to all listening apps
bus.broadcast('system:themeChanged', { theme: 'dark' });
```

**See also:** [WebGPU OS Architecture](/webgpu-os/architecture.md) · [Security Model](/concepts/security-model.md)
